notes.title: Game update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41183946/9f58a74753afe49aaadad73b52c7e6fa2eaa831b.png

We have listened to your feedback and are happy to update the game with the following changes:

Changes

 Game Engine has been updated to Unity [strike]2021.3[/strike] 2021.3.15
 Added ingame control sheet (readme)
 Microphone - You can now use CAPSLOCK key to speak.
Ensure that you'll set your default microphone within Windows.


Instructions
There were some complaints about instructions. Ingame most controls were visible on the display already by toggling with the TAB key. However, we now included the new question mark icon top-right which will open a modal with instructions. You can also press ESCAPE en then choose for controls option.

notes.title: Release date available!
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce the release date of the Power Polyp Simulator:
December 2nd 2022 8PM CET

History
Many of you might know that the game was available for free on its initial release back in 2019. We decided to take it down after a while to improve the game engine, update a lot of things in the background and make some slight improvements in gameplay/graphics.

We have done all of that and are glad to announce the release date. You can see the Major Update list for the changes that are coming up. 

Why Steam?
Using Steam for our game means that we can now push updates seamless to our players, a great way to keep it up to date and keep adding new features.

We hope that you'll enjoy our simulator game and keep supporting us for future simulators! As a great deal we will have a 10% discount on the release date. 

Don't forget to add the game to your wish list!

notes.title: Game update v1.2
notes.notes:
This update contains a small fix and a few updates.


 Game Engine has been updated to Unity [strike]2020.3[/strike] 2021.3
 Overal game engine performance improved
 Start screen contains background music and switching backgrounds
 Removed jingles due to copyright audio
 Added the option to add your own Jingles with name (jingle_xx.wav). Replace xx with numbers 1 - 12 for the F (function) keys.
 Added cookies to the spotlights for a more realistic effect
 Added a second location (empty, better performance)
 Added light beam effect on the center sphere
 Ready for release
